architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

services.role_in_journey: Creates and owns CHAPSPaymentIntent (ENT-053). Publishes CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated, CHAPSPaymentAuthorised. Debits customer account on receipt of CHAPSPaymentSettled. Owns the definitive account balance.

consumed_events.name: CHAPSPaymentSettled
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 PH-081→PH-082: SVC-001 debits ENT-004 (Account) by the settled amount. Updates CHAPSPaymentIntent (ENT-053) status to completed. Publishes AccountDebited (EVT-P06 CHAPS variant). Updates Account.chaps_daily_total. Idempotent on chaps_execution_id.

consumed_events.name: CHAPSPaymentFailed
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 EXC-003, EXC-004: SVC-001 releases reserved funds. Updates ENT-053 status to failed. Triggers customer notification via SVC-053.

consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-001 calls SVC-100 for SCA dynamic linking at payment authorisation (PSR 2017 Reg 100). SCA token must be cryptographically linked to amount and beneficiary.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-001 owns CHAPSPaymentIntent (ENT-053) because it owns the customer account and manages the pre-authorisation phase (CoP, sanctions gate, SCA). SVC-009 owns CHAPSPaymentExecution (ENT-052) because it owns the submission-to-settlement lifecycle.
design_decisions.rationale: Clean boundary: SVC-001 manages the customer interaction and consent; SVC-009 manages the RTGS interaction. The handoff point is CHAPSPaymentAuthorised (EVT-110).

services.role_in_journey: Owns CHAPSPaymentExecution (ENT-052). Proxies CoP check (PH-078). Constructs and submits ISO 20022 pacs.008 to Bank of England RTGS. Monitors settlement. Publishes CHAPSPaymentSettled, CHAPSPaymentFailed, MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed.

consumed_events.name: CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 PH-077→PH-078: SVC-009 receives new CHAPS intent. Initiates CoP check against Pay.UK CoP service. Creates CHAPSCoPCheck record internally.

field_mappings.note: Sets payment_intent_id FK on ENT-052 (created at PH-081 after EVT-110)

consumed_events.name: SanctionsScreeningCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 PH-079: SVC-009 (acting as orchestrator for CHAPS flow) receives sanctions result. If clear: publishes CHAPSCoPCheckCompleted → allows PH-080 to proceed. If hit: publishes SanctionsHitDetected (EVT-006).

consumed_events.name: CHAPSPaymentAuthorised
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 PH-080→PH-081: Triggers CHAPS execution. SVC-009 creates CHAPSPaymentExecution (ENT-052), generates UETR, constructs ISO 20022 pacs.008, submits to RTGS.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous (blocking, P99 < 3,000ms with fallback to unavailable)
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-009 proxies CoP check on behalf of the channel. Returns cop_result to SVC-001 via EVT-109. Channels never call Pay.UK CoP directly.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous message submission (ISO 20022 pacs.008), async settlement confirmation
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-009 submits CHAPS payment instruction to RTGS. RTGS returns acceptance or rejection synchronously. Settlement confirmation arrives as an async callback from RTGS. SVC-009 uses Form3 or Bottomline PTX connectivity layer.

chaps_connectivity.enhanced_data_from: 1 May 2025 — LEIs and Purpose Codes mandatory (GOV-003-R03)
chaps_connectivity.build_vs_buy: Buy — Form3 or Bottomline PTX CHAPS connectivity. SVC-009 is the bank-owned orchestration layer. Same connectivity vendor as FPS/BACS.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-009 handles both FPS and CHAPS rail execution. CHAPS is a separate entity (ENT-052) but uses the same SVC-009 orchestration layer.
design_decisions.rationale: CHAPS retained as sub-capability of CAP-003 (0/4 promotion criteria met). Same operational team, same connectivity vendor, different message format and regulatory obligations. SVC-009 internal routing handles the rail differences.

services.role_in_journey: Orchestrates sanctions screening at PH-079 via SVC-051. Receives CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated (EVT-108, high-value monitoring). For amounts >= £10,000, triggers enhanced real-time monitoring.

consumed_events.name: CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 PH-077→PH-079: SVC-014 receives the intent and, if enhanced_monitoring_flag = true (amount >= £10k), initiates enhanced real-time AML monitoring for the payment. For all payments: orchestrates beneficiary sanctions screening.

field_mappings.note: Associates CHAPS payment with existing KYC monitoring record for the customer

consumed_apis.purpose: Screens beneficiary name and account details against OFSI/UN/EU sanctions lists. Result published as EVT-P02 (SanctionsScreeningCompleted) or EVT-006 (SanctionsHitDetected).

design_decisions.decision: SVC-014 handles sanctions screening for CHAPS identically to FPS (JRN-002 pattern), consuming CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated instead of PaymentIntentCreated.
design_decisions.rationale: Reuses the existing sanctions screening orchestration. Cross-capability event subscription (CAP-003 → CAP-005 via Event Bus). No new compliance infrastructure required.

services.role_in_journey: Consumes MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed (EVT-112) to update MortgageAccount.status to completed. This completes the JRN-006 mortgage completion lifecycle.

consumed_events.name: MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 PH-082: SVC-002 transitions MortgageAccount (ENT-016) status to 'completed'. Triggers completion documentation dispatch. Completes the JRN-006 mortgage lifecycle.

field_mappings.note: Sets the formal completion date on the mortgage record

design_decisions.decision: SVC-002 (CAP-001) consumes MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed (EVT-112) from SVC-009 (CAP-003) via the Event Bus. No synchronous cross-capability call.
design_decisions.rationale: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events (architecture-specification.md §2.4). SVC-002 must not call SVC-009 to poll for payment settlement status.

cross_service_interaction_summary.note: Channel calls CAP-003 API for CoP. SVC-009 internally calls Pay.UK CoP service.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Synchronous REST — payment intent creation and authorisation
cross_service_interaction_summary.note: Channel calls CAP-001 API to create CHAPSPaymentIntent and submit SCA authorisation.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Async event via Event Bus — CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated (EVT-108)
cross_service_interaction_summary.note: CAP-001 → CAP-003 boundary. Triggers CoP and sanctions orchestration.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Async event via Event Bus — CHAPSPaymentAuthorised (EVT-110)
cross_service_interaction_summary.note: CAP-001 → CAP-003 boundary. Triggers RTGS submission.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Async event via Event Bus — CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated (EVT-108) consumed by SVC-014
cross_service_interaction_summary.note: CAP-001 → CAP-005 boundary. SVC-014 subscribes to high-value payment intents for AML monitoring.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Async event via Event Bus — CHAPSPaymentSettled (EVT-111)
cross_service_interaction_summary.note: CAP-003 → CAP-001 boundary. Triggers account debit.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Async event via Event Bus — MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed (EVT-112)
cross_service_interaction_summary.note: CAP-003 → CAP-001 boundary. Completes the JRN-006 mortgage lifecycle.
